text:
Quorum commands (you are Admin):
quorum_help: This list: every command and what it does  [anyone]
quorum_start: Guided setup: a few questions (team size, name, focus, capture, teammates), then it configures the workspace  [anyone / admin applies]
quorum_status: What is remembered, what will be remembered, what is shared with whom, who is connected, tokens saved  [anyone]
retrieve_context: Look up what the team knows about a question (compact mode costs the fewest tokens)  [anyone]
remember_fact: Save a fact with its source; scope=team keeps it private to your team  [contributor+]
observe: Save the durable facts already in some text, without one call per fact  [contributor+]
derive: Record a conclusion built on parent facts, so a bad parent can take it back  [contributor+]
stage_action: Propose an action; the safety gate decides, risky ones go to a person  [contributor+]
execute_action: Run a staged action under the guard (refused if any fact behind it is quarantined)  [contributor+]
quarantine: Pull a wrong fact and everything built on it out of circulation  [reviewer+]
restore: Bring it back, only where every parent is healthy again  [reviewer+]
explain_blast_radius: Dry run: what a quarantine would touch  [anyone]
review_handoff: Approve or reject a task the gate sent to a person  [admin]
claim_handoff: Take a task with an exclusive lease  [contributor+]
get_map: A few hundred tokens that orient you in the shared memory  [anyone]
get_node: One node with its parents and children  [anyone]
find_path: How two facts are connected (FalkorDB shortest path)  [anyone]
delta: What stopped being true since you last looked  [anyone]
announce_work: Say what you are about to work on (a file, an order, a ticket); get a warning if someone else is on it or near it  [contributor+]
recall_as_of: What the team believed at an earlier time, and what happened to those facts since  [anyone]
quorum_manage: Teams, people, permission levels, tokens and sharing links, all from chat (action=overview lists what you can do)  [admin]
quorum_discover: Other Quorum hubs visible on this network  [anyone]
quorum_connect: Ask to join a hub you discovered; its admin is notified and approves  [admin]
quorum_inbox: Connection requests waiting for you  [admin]
quorum_respond: Approve or decline a connection request, choosing the permission level  [admin]
quorum_connections: Hubs you are connected to, requests you sent, and the MCP settings to attach them  [admin]
peer_retrieve: Ask a connected hub a question; you see only what its admin shared with you  [admin]
Start with quorum_start if this is a new workspace, or quorum_status to see where things stand.

Welcome to Quorum: shared memory your AIs and teammates can trust, with a one-step undo for wrong facts.
Ask these questions one at a time, then call quorum_start again with the answers:
1. How many people will share this memory (including you)?
2. What should your team be called?
3. What will you mostly use it for? (customer support/engineering/operations/research/something else)
4. Should durable facts from your chats be saved automatically (you can review and quarantine them any time)?
5. Look for teammates already running Quorum on this network?
Commands: call quorum_help.
